evidence.detail: R362 TextParticleMarkup is the only exact-v308 class that constructs or references rs/l/u.
rs/l/u extends LinkedHashMap<Long,Long>, is constructed access-ordered with initial capacity 64/load factor 0.75, and evicts the eldest entry only when size exceeds 512.

TextParticleMarkup computes a composite long key from the source String hash plus markup span indexes, stores System.nanoTime()/1_000_000 as the value, and if the stored timestamp is less than 50 ms old returns the previous selected variant array instead of re-randomizing.
The cache participates only in TextParticleMarkup's up-to-three unique palette/image variant selection path; particle spawning, motion and lifetime remain owned by TextParticleMarkup itself.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the bounded timestamp cache that stabilizes TextParticleMarkup variant selection across a 50 ms window.
